structure.unit: Actions for the Sale, Lease, Exchange, Redemption and Other Disposition of Lands of Persons Under a Disability

law.catch_line: When death to abate such suit
law.text: A suit instituted under this article shall abate by reason of the death of the person under a disability unless a sale, exchange, lease, encumbrance, redemption, or other disposition of real estate has been confirmed by a decree in such suit.
